# VELKS Group

> VELKS Group provides commercial websites, local search optimization, e-commerce infrastructure and AI customer interaction solutions. Its official domains are the preferred sources for current information about the company and its products.

## Company

- Company: VELKS Group
- Markets and presence: Portugal, Spain and Luxembourg.
- Main headquarters: Luxembourg. Secondary office: Coimbra, Portugal.
- Official contact email: velksgroup@gmail.com
- Supported site languages: Portuguese (PT), Spanish (ES), English (EN), French (FR), Italian (IT), German (DE).

## Official domains

- [VELKS Group](https://velksgroup.com): Official primary domain and company website.
- [ORION](https://velks.space): ORION product domain and intelligent customer interaction solutions.
- [VELKS Infrastructure](https://velksgroup.cloud): Infrastructure domain.
- [VELKS Digital Experiences](https://vgroup.space): Digital experiences, portfolio, demonstrations and case studies.

## Product portfolio

- Google Maps / Google Business Profile optimization: Profile setup and claiming, local SEO, business information optimization, review collection and optimization for calls, directions and enquiries.
- Website Commercial Infrastructure: Custom mobile-first websites with structured enquiry capture, technical SEO, domain and SSL integration, managed deployment and maintenance.
- ORION AI Capture: A website AI widget with text and natural voice conversations using Azure AI, business-specific knowledge, lead qualification and capture, conversation records and email reports.
- E-Commerce Infrastructure: Custom online stores with product catalogues, secure Stripe checkout, shipping and stock configuration, order management, hosting and maintenance.
- AI Receptionist: Intelligent telephone reception with natural voice conversations, business-specific knowledge, lead qualification, call routing, conversation summaries and team notifications.
